questions.subject: PHYSICS
questions.prompt: The ideal mechanical advantage (I.M.A.) of a simple machine is always
options: greater than the actual mechanical advantage
it depends upon the nature of the simple machine
sometimes greater than and sometimes less than actual mechanical advantage
explanation_steps: IMA = effort distance / load distance (no friction). AMA accounts for friction so AMA < IMA always (efficiency <100%).

questions.subject: PHYSICS
questions.prompt: Which of the following is true about light?
options: the law of reflection states that the angle of incidence is equal to the angle of refraction
if rays start from a point and spread to different directions, then the beam is called a converging beam
Solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between the Earth and the Sun
Light travels in a straight line when it crosses the interface between 2 media
explanation_steps: Solar eclipse: Moon between Earth and Sun. Reflection law is i=r not refraction. Diverging beam spreads; light bends at interface (refraction).
